prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "She": a / book / in / the / library / She / is / reading.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "She": a / book / in / the / library / She / is / reading.

choices: She is reading a book in the library.
Reading she is a book library in the.
Is she a book reading in library the.
Book a reading is she library in the.
questions.answer: She is reading a book in the library.

explain.en: Keep She before is reading, followed by a book and the place phrase in the library.
explain.zh: She 是主语，后接 is reading，再接 a book 和地点短语 in the library。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "My mother": dinner / every / evening / My / mother / cooks.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "My mother": dinner / every / evening / My / mother / cooks.

choices: My mother cooks dinner every evening.
Dinner cooks my mother every evening.
Every evening dinner my mother cooks.
Cooks my mother dinner every evening.
questions.answer: My mother cooks dinner every evening.

explain.en: Begin with My mother, then cooks dinner, and finish with the time phrase every evening.
explain.zh: 先写 My mother，再写 cooks dinner，最后加时间短语 every evening。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "The children": playing / in / the / field / The / children / are.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "The children": playing / in / the / field / The / children / are.

choices: The children are playing in the field.
Are the children field playing in the.
Playing are the children in the field.
In the field are playing the children.
questions.answer: The children are playing in the field.

explain.en: The children is the subject. Are playing is the verb phrase, followed by the place in the field.
explain.zh: The children 是主语，are playing 是动词短语，in the field 说明地点；这里不需要宾语。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "I": school / by / bus / every / day / I / go / to.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "I": school / by / bus / every / day / I / go / to.

choices: I go to school by bus every day.
By bus I every day go to school.
To school go I by bus every day.
Every day by bus school I go to.
questions.answer: I go to school by bus every day.

explain.en: After I, use go to school, then by bus and every day to explain travel and time.
explain.zh: I 后接 go to school，再用 by bus 和 every day 说明交通方式和时间。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "We": grandmother / last / weekend / We / visited / our.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "We": grandmother / last / weekend / We / visited / our.

choices: We visited our grandmother last weekend.
Last weekend we grandmother our visited.
Grandmother our we visited last weekend.
Visited we our grandmother last weekend.
questions.answer: We visited our grandmother last weekend.

explain.en: We is followed by visited, the object our grandmother, and the time last weekend.
explain.zh: We 后接 visited，宾语是 our grandmother，最后是时间 last weekend。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "The teacher": us / homework / today / The / teacher / gave.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "The teacher": us / homework / today / The / teacher / gave.

choices: The teacher gave us homework today.
Homework the teacher today gave us.
Gave us the teacher homework today.
Today homework gave the teacher us.
questions.answer: The teacher gave us homework today.

explain.en: The teacher is the subject, gave is the verb, us names the receivers and homework names what was given.
explain.zh: The teacher 是主语，gave 是动词；us 表示接受者，homework 表示所给的东西。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "My father": to / work / every / morning / My / father / drives.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "My father": to / work / every / morning / My / father / drives.

choices: My father drives to work every morning.
Every morning drives my father to work.
To work my father every morning drives.
Drives to work my father every morning.
questions.answer: My father drives to work every morning.

explain.en: Begin with My father, then drives to work, followed by every morning.
explain.zh: 题目指定从 My father 开始，接着是 drives to work，最后是 every morning。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "The cat": sleeping / under / the / table / The / cat / is.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "The cat": sleeping / under / the / table / The / cat / is.

choices: The cat is sleeping under the table.
Under the table the cat is sleeping.
Sleeping is the cat under the table.
Is sleeping under the cat the table.
questions.answer: The cat is sleeping under the table.

explain.en: The requested beginning is The cat. Follow it with is sleeping and then under the table.
explain.zh: 题目指定以 The cat 开始，后接 is sleeping 和地点 under the table；地点短语放句首也可能正确，但不符合本题指定的开头。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "Although": raining / we / still / went / to / the / park / Although / it / was.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "Although": raining / we / still / went / to / the / park / Although / it / was.

choices: Although it was raining, we still went to the park.
Although raining it was, went we still to the park.
We went still to the park, although it was raining, we.
It was raining although, still we went to the park.
questions.answer: Although it was raining, we still went to the park.

explain.en: Although introduces the first clause it was raining. A comma separates it from we still went to the park.
explain.zh: Although 引出 it was raining 这个从句，再用逗号与主句 we still went to the park 分开。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "Before": the / house / remember / to / lock / the / door / Before / you / leave.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "Before": the / house / remember / to / lock / the / door / Before / you / leave.

choices: Before you leave the house, remember to lock the door.
Remember lock the door, before you leave to the house.
The door before you leave, remember to lock the house.
Lock the door remember, before leave you the house to.
questions.answer: Before you leave the house, remember to lock the door.

explain.en: Before you leave the house is the time clause. The main instruction is remember to lock the door.
explain.zh: Before you leave the house 是时间从句；主要指示是 remember to lock the door。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "Because": every / day / she / won / the / competition / Because / she / practised.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "Because": every / day / she / won / the / competition / Because / she / practised.

choices: Because she practised every day, she won the competition.
Because every day she practised, won the competition she.
She won the competition, because every day practised she.
Practised every day because she, she the competition won.
questions.answer: Because she practised every day, she won the competition.

explain.en: Because introduces the reason she practised every day. The main clause tells the result: she won the competition.
explain.zh: Because 引出每天练习这个原因；主句 she won the competition 说明结果。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "The book": I / borrowed / from / the / library / is / very / interesting / The / book / that.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "The book": I / borrowed / from / the / library / is / very / interesting / The / book / that.

choices: The book that I borrowed from the library is very interesting.
The book I borrowed that from the library is very interesting.
That I borrowed the book from the library is very interesting.
Very interesting is the book that I borrowed from the library that.
questions.answer: The book that I borrowed from the library is very interesting.

explain.en: That I borrowed from the library stays beside The book to describe which book. Is very interesting completes the sentence.
explain.zh: That I borrowed from the library 紧接 The book，说明是哪一本书；is very interesting 完成句子。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "My sister and I": I / share / a / bedroom / My / sister / and.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "My sister and I": I / share / a / bedroom / My / sister / and.

choices: My sister and I share a bedroom.
A bedroom my sister and I share.
Share my sister and I a bedroom.
I and my sister a bedroom share.
questions.answer: My sister and I share a bedroom.

explain.en: Begin with the requested subject My sister and I, then use share a bedroom.
explain.zh: 题目指定以主语 My sister and I 开头，再接 share a bedroom。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "The farmer": the / chickens / every / morning / The / farmer / feeds.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "The farmer": the / chickens / every / morning / The / farmer / feeds.

choices: The farmer feeds the chickens every morning.
Every morning the chickens feeds the farmer.
Feeds the farmer every morning the chickens.
The chickens every morning feeds the farmer.
questions.answer: The farmer feeds the chickens every morning.

explain.en: The farmer does the action, feeds. The chickens receive the food, and every morning gives the time.
explain.zh: The farmer 是喂食的人，feeds 是动作，the chickens 是对象，every morning 是时间。

prompt.en: Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "After": homework / she / watched / her / favourite / cartoon / After / finishing / her.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Arrange these words into a sentence beginning with "After": homework / she / watched / her / favourite / cartoon / After / finishing / her.

choices: After finishing her homework, she watched her favourite cartoon.
After finishing homework her, she watched her favourite cartoon.
She watched her favourite cartoon, after finishing her homework she.
Finishing after her homework, watched she her favourite cartoon.
questions.answer: After finishing her homework, she watched her favourite cartoon.

explain.en: After finishing her homework is a complete opening phrase. She watched her favourite cartoon is the main clause.
explain.zh: After finishing her homework 是完整的开头短语，后接主句 she watched her favourite cartoon。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for introducing Ali.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for introducing Ali.

choices: My name is Ali and I am ten years old.
my name is ali and i am ten years old.
My Name Is Ali And I Am Ten Years Old.
My name is ali and I am ten years old
questions.answer: My name is Ali and I am ten years old.

explain.en: A sentence starts with a capital. The name Ali and the pronoun I also need capitals; finish the statement with a full stop.
explain.zh: 句首、名字 Ali 和代词 I 要大写；陈述句末用句号。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for asking about Kuala Lumpur.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for asking about Kuala Lumpur.

choices: Do you live in Kuala Lumpur?
do you live in kuala lumpur
Do you live in kuala Lumpur.
Do You Live In Kuala Lumpur?
questions.answer: Do you live in Kuala Lumpur?

explain.en: Start Do with a capital, capitalise both parts of Kuala Lumpur, and end the question with ?.
explain.zh: 句首 Do 及地名 Kuala Lumpur 要大写；问句末用问号。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for a holiday in Penang.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for a holiday in Penang.

choices: We went to Penang for the holidays.
we went to penang for the holidays.
We went to penang for the Holidays
We Went To Penang For The Holidays.
questions.answer: We went to Penang for the holidays.

explain.en: We starts the sentence, Penang is a place name, and a full stop ends the statement.
explain.zh: 句首 We 与地名 Penang 要大写；陈述句末用句号。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and an exclamation mark to show strong surprise at a sunset.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and an exclamation mark to show strong surprise at a sunset.

choices: What a beautiful sunset!
what a beautiful sunset
What A Beautiful Sunset!
What a beautiful sunset.
questions.answer: What a beautiful sunset!

explain.en: The task asks for strong surprise, so use an exclamation mark. Ordinary words inside the sentence stay lower case.
explain.zh: 题目指定表达强烈惊叹，所以句末用感叹号；普通词不必每个字都大写。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for listing three friends.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for listing three friends.

choices: Aisyah, Ben and Mei Ling are my friends.
aisyah, ben and mei ling are my friends.
Aisyah Ben and Mei Ling are my friends.
Aisyah, ben and Mei ling are my Friends.
questions.answer: Aisyah, Ben and Mei Ling are my friends.

explain.en: Capitalise each person's name. A comma separates the first name from the rest of the list.
explain.zh: 每个人的名字都要大写；列举三个名字时，第一项后用逗号分隔。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for listing three pets.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for listing three pets.

choices: I have a dog, a cat and a rabbit.
i have a dog a cat and a rabbit.
I have a dog, a cat, and a Rabbit
I Have A Dog, A Cat And A Rabbit.
questions.answer: I have a dog, a cat and a rabbit.

explain.en: Start with I, use a comma in the three-item list, and end with a full stop. Pet names used as common nouns stay lower case.
explain.zh: 句首 I 要大写，列举三种宠物时用逗号，句末用句号；普通动物名称不必大写。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for asking for help.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for asking for help.

choices: Can you help me, please?
can you help me please
Can you help me, please.
Can You Help Me, Please?
questions.answer: Can you help me, please?

explain.en: Can starts the question, the comma sets off please, and ? marks the question.
explain.zh: Can 在句首大写，please 前可用逗号隔开，句末用问号。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for a reading club on Monday.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for a reading club on Monday.

choices: Our reading club meets on Monday.
our reading club meets on monday.
Our Reading Club Meets On Monday.
Our reading club meets on monday
questions.answer: Our reading club meets on Monday.

explain.en: Capitalise Our at the start and Monday as a day name. The other ordinary words stay lower case.
explain.zh: 句首 Our 和星期名称 Monday 要大写；其他普通词用小写。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for quoting Hafiz's words.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for quoting Hafiz's words.

choices: "I am tired," said Hafiz, "so I will rest now."
I am tired, said Hafiz, so I will rest now.
"i am tired," said hafiz, "so i will rest now."
"I am tired" said Hafiz "so I will rest now"
questions.answer: "I am tired," said Hafiz, "so I will rest now."

explain.en: Quotation marks surround the exact words spoken. Commas separate said Hafiz from the two parts of the speech.
explain.zh: 引号包住说话内容；said Hafiz 与前后两段话之间用逗号分开。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for Mrs Tan visiting Ipoh.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for Mrs Tan visiting Ipoh.

choices: Mrs. Tan, our class teacher, will visit Ipoh next week.
mrs tan our class teacher will visit ipoh next week.
Mrs Tan, our Class Teacher, will visit Ipoh next week
Mrs. tan, our class teacher, will visit ipoh next week.
questions.answer: Mrs. Tan, our class teacher, will visit Ipoh next week.

explain.en: Mrs Tan and Ipoh are names. Commas surround the extra information our class teacher, and the statement ends with a full stop.
explain.zh: Mrs Tan 与 Ipoh 属于名字；额外说明 our class teacher 前后用逗号，句末用句号。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for asking about Malaysia's capital.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for asking about Malaysia's capital.

choices: Did you know that Malaysia's capital is Kuala Lumpur?
did you know that malaysia's capital is kuala lumpur
Did you know that Malaysias' capital is Kuala Lumpur?
Did you know that Malaysia's Capital is kuala lumpur?
questions.answer: Did you know that Malaysia's capital is Kuala Lumpur?

explain.en: Malaysia's needs apostrophe + s for possession. Kuala Lumpur is capitalised and the question ends with ?.
explain.zh: Malaysia's 用撇号和 s 表示所属；Kuala Lumpur 要大写，问句末用问号。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for asking about a school bag.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for asking about a school bag.

choices: Where is my school bag?
where is my school bag
Where is my school Bag?
Where Is My School Bag?
questions.answer: Where is my school bag?

explain.en: Where starts with a capital, ordinary words like bag stay lower case, and the question ends with ?.
explain.zh: 句首 Where 要大写；bag 等普通词用小写，句末用问号。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for giving a Jalan Bunga address.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for giving a Jalan Bunga address.

choices: I live at No. 12, Jalan Bunga.
i live at no. 12, jalan bunga.
I live at no. 12, Jalan bunga
I Live At No. 12, Jalan Bunga
questions.answer: I live at No. 12, Jalan Bunga.

explain.en: Start with I, capitalise the road name Jalan Bunga, and use punctuation to separate the house number and road.
explain.zh: 句首 I 和路名 Jalan Bunga 要大写；门牌号码与路名之间用适当标点分隔。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for showing surprise at a painting.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with correct capital letters and punctuation for showing surprise at a painting.

choices: Wow, that's an amazing painting!
wow, that's an amazing painting!
Wow, thats an amazing painting.
Wow that's an Amazing Painting!
questions.answer: Wow, that's an amazing painting!

explain.en: That's needs an apostrophe because it means that is. An exclamation mark fits the surprised Wow.
explain.zh: That's 是 that is 的缩写，必须有撇号；Wow 表示惊叹，句末用感叹号。

prompt.en: Q: ___ is your name? A: My name is Ravi.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Q: ___ is your name? A: My name is Ravi.

choices: What
Where
When
Who
questions.answer: What

explain.en: What asks for information such as a name. The answer gives Ravi's name.
explain.zh: What 可以询问名字；回答提供 Ravi 的名字。

prompt.en: Q: ___ do you live? A: I live in Ipoh.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Q: ___ do you live? A: I live in Ipoh.

choices: Where
What
When
Why
questions.answer: Where

explain.en: Where asks about a place; Ipoh is the place given in the answer.
explain.zh: Where 用来询问地点；回答中的 Ipoh 是地点。

prompt.en: Q: ___ is your birthday? A: My birthday is on 5 May.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Q: ___ is your birthday? A: My birthday is on 5 May.

choices: When
Where
What
How
questions.answer: When

explain.en: When asks about time or a date; 5 May is a date.
explain.zh: When 询问时间或日期；5 May 是日期。

prompt.en: Q: ___ is that boy over there? A: He is my cousin, Danial.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Q: ___ is that boy over there? A: He is my cousin, Danial.

choices: Who
What
Where
When
questions.answer: Who

explain.en: Who asks about a person; the answer identifies the boy as Danial.
explain.zh: Who 询问人物；回答说明男孩是 Danial。

prompt.en: Q: ___ old are you? A: I am ten years old.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Q: ___ old are you? A: I am ten years old.

choices: How
What
Where
Why
questions.answer: How

explain.en: How old is the phrase used to ask a person's age.
explain.zh: 询问年龄的固定问法是 How old。

prompt.en: Q: ___ did you cry? A: Because I lost my pencil.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Q: ___ did you cry? A: Because I lost my pencil.

choices: Why
What
When
Who
questions.answer: Why

explain.en: Why asks for a reason; Because I lost my pencil gives that reason.
explain.zh: Why 询问原因，Because I lost my pencil 正是原因。

prompt.en: Q: ___ books do you have? A: I have five books.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Q: ___ books do you have? A: I have five books.

choices: How many
How much
What kind
Which way
questions.answer: How many

explain.en: How many asks for the number of countable things. Books can be counted and five is a number.
explain.zh: Books 可以数，回答是数量 five，所以用 How many。

prompt.en: Which is the correct question for the answer "Yes, I like durian."?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which is the correct question for the answer "Yes, I like durian."?

choices: Do you like durian?
Does you like durian?
Are you like durian?
Is you like durian?
questions.answer: Do you like durian?

explain.en: With you, a present-simple yes/no question uses Do + you + like.
explain.zh: 主语是 you，一般现在式的是非问句用 Do you like，而不是 Does 或 Are。

prompt.en: Which is the correct question for the answer "She went to school by bicycle."?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which is the correct question for the answer "She went to school by bicycle."?

choices: How did she go to school?
How does she go to school?
How she went to school?
How was she go to school?
questions.answer: How did she go to school?

explain.en: How asks about the method of travel. For the past action went, the question uses did + go.
explain.zh: How 询问交通方式；回答用过去式 went，疑问句用 did 加原形 go。

prompt.en: Which is the correct question for the answer "There are thirty students in my class."?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which is the correct question for the answer "There are thirty students in my class."?

choices: How many students are there in your class?
How much students are there in your class?
How many students is there in your class?
How many student are there in your class?
questions.answer: How many students are there in your class?

explain.en: Students is plural and countable, so use How many students are there ...?
explain.zh: Students 是可数复数名词，所以用 How many，并配合 are there。

prompt.en: Which is the correct question for the answer "It costs two ringgit."?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which is the correct question for the answer "It costs two ringgit."?

choices: How much does it cost?
How many does it cost?
How much is it costs?
How much cost it does?
questions.answer: How much does it cost?

explain.en: How much asks the price. After does, cost stays in its base form.
explain.zh: How much 询问价格；does 后的 cost 用原形。

prompt.en: Q: ___ is the weather like today? A: It is sunny and hot.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Q: ___ is the weather like today? A: It is sunny and hot.

choices: What
Where
Who
When
questions.answer: What

explain.en: What is the weather like? asks for a description, such as sunny and hot.
explain.zh: What is the weather like? 用来询问天气状况，回答可描述为 sunny and hot。

prompt.en: Q: ___ does the school bus arrive? A: At seven in the morning.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Q: ___ does the school bus arrive? A: At seven in the morning.

choices: When
Where
Why
Who
questions.answer: When

explain.en: When asks for an arrival time. At seven in the morning supplies that time.
explain.zh: When 询问到达时间；回答给出早上七点。

prompt.en: Which is the correct question for the answer "Because she wanted to surprise her mother."?
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Which is the correct question for the answer "Because she wanted to surprise her mother."?

choices: Why did she bake a cake?
Why she did bake a cake?
Why does she baked a cake?
Why did she baking a cake?
questions.answer: Why did she bake a cake?

explain.en: Why asks for a reason. A past-simple question uses did + she + bake, not baked or baking.
explain.zh: Why 询问原因；过去式疑问句用 did she bake，bake 保留原形。

prompt.en: The sunlight is very bright, so I will protect my eyes by wearing ___.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The sunlight is very bright, so I will protect my eyes by wearing ___.

choices: sunglasses
raincoat
sweater
boots
questions.answer: sunglasses

explain.en: Sunglasses protect the eyes from bright sunlight; the clue is protect my eyes.
explain.zh: Sunglasses 是太阳眼镜；protect my eyes 和 bright sunlight 提供了线索。

prompt.en: I forgot to bring my umbrella, and now my clothes are getting ___ in the rain.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。I forgot to bring my umbrella, and now my clothes are getting ___ in the rain.

choices: wet
dry
dusty
tidy
questions.answer: wet

explain.en: Rain adds water to the clothes, making them wet rather than dry.
explain.zh: 雨水让衣服沾上水，因此是 wet（湿的），不是 dry（干的）。

prompt.en: After the long race, she had little energy left. She felt ___ and needed to rest.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。After the long race, she had little energy left. She felt ___ and needed to rest.

choices: tired
excited
hungry
thirsty
questions.answer: tired

explain.en: Little energy and needing rest describe being tired.
explain.zh: Little energy 和 needed to rest 说明身体疲累，因此选 tired。

prompt.en: Before we eat, we must wash our ___.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Before we eat, we must wash our ___.

choices: hands
hair
shoes
books
questions.answer: hands

explain.en: Washing hands before eating helps remove dirt from the part used to handle food.
explain.zh: 饭前应清洗用来接触食物的双手，因此选 hands。

prompt.en: The library is a quiet place, so we must not ___ loudly.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The library is a quiet place, so we must not ___ loudly.

choices: talk
draw
write
sit
questions.answer: talk

explain.en: Talk can be loud and disturb readers. The other actions do not normally make a voice sound.
explain.zh: Talk 是说话，大声说话会影响读者；其他动作一般不会发出说话声。

prompt.en: It is very dark, so please switch on the ___.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。It is very dark, so please switch on the ___.

choices: light
fan
radio
window
questions.answer: light

explain.en: Switching on a light makes a dark place brighter.
explain.zh: 打开 light（灯）能照亮黑暗的地方。

prompt.en: My little brother cannot reach the shelf because he is too ___.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。My little brother cannot reach the shelf because he is too ___.

choices: short
tall
fast
strong
questions.answer: short

explain.en: Not reaching a high shelf is a clue about height. Too short means not tall enough.
explain.zh: 够不到高架子是身高的线索；too short 表示不够高。

prompt.en: We should recycle paper and plastic to help protect the ___.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。We should recycle paper and plastic to help protect the ___.

choices: environment
homework
kitchen
calculator
questions.answer: environment

explain.en: Recycling reduces waste and helps protect the environment around us.
explain.zh: 回收纸和塑料可减少垃圾，保护 environment（环境）。

prompt.en: The soup is too hot, so I will wait for it to ___ before eating.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。The soup is too hot, so I will wait for it to ___ before eating.

choices: cool down
warm up
melt
freeze
questions.answer: cool down

explain.en: Cool down means become less hot; it does not mean freeze.
explain.zh: Cool down 表示温度降低、没那么烫，并不表示结冰。

prompt.en: I was worried about the test and my hands were shaking. I felt ___ before it started.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。I was worried about the test and my hands were shaking. I felt ___ before it started.

choices: nervous
confident
proud
relaxed
questions.answer: nervous

explain.en: Feeling worried and having shaking hands are clues to nervousness.
explain.zh: 担心和手发抖是紧张的线索，所以选 nervous。

prompt.en: Even though he was the youngest in the team, he was chosen as the ___ because of his leadership skills.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Even though he was the youngest in the team, he was chosen as the ___ because of his leadership skills.

choices: captain
audience
spectator
referee
questions.answer: captain

explain.en: A captain leads a team. Audience and spectator refer to people watching.
explain.zh: Captain 是带领队伍的队长；audience 和 spectator 是观看的人。

prompt.en: The scientist carried out an ___ to test whether the plant would grow faster in sunlight.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。The scientist carried out an ___ to test whether the plant would grow faster in sunlight.

choices: experiment
argument
agreement
announcement
questions.answer: experiment

explain.en: An experiment is a planned test used to investigate a question, such as how sunlight affects growth.
explain.zh: Experiment 是为了探究问题而进行的实验，例如测试阳光是否影响生长。

prompt.en: Despite the heavy traffic, we managed to arrive ___ for the meeting.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Despite the heavy traffic, we managed to arrive ___ for the meeting.

choices: on time
for time
at time
by time
questions.answer: on time

explain.en: On time means at the planned time; despite shows that the traffic did not make them late.
explain.zh: On time 表示准时；despite 说明虽然交通拥挤，他们仍按时到达。

prompt.en: The old bridge was so ___ that the town council decided to close it for repairs.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。The old bridge was so ___ that the town council decided to close it for repairs.

choices: unsafe
convenient
colourful
popular
questions.answer: unsafe

explain.en: Closing a bridge for repairs suggests it is unsafe to use.
explain.zh: 需要封桥维修，说明桥梁使用起来不安全，因此选 unsafe。

prompt.en: Her ___ to help the injured bird showed how kind-hearted she was.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。Her ___ to help the injured bird showed how kind-hearted she was.

choices: willingness
reluctance
refusal
complaint
questions.answer: willingness

explain.en: Willingness means being ready to help. Refusal and reluctance would not support the description kind-hearted.
explain.zh: Willingness 表示乐意；拒绝或不情愿都不符合 kind-hearted（心地善良）的描述。

prompt.en: The classroom was very messy, so the teacher asked us to ___ it up.
prompt.zh: 选出正确的答案。The classroom was very messy, so the teacher asked us to ___ it up.

choices: tidy
break
paint
lock
questions.answer: tidy

explain.en: Tidy up means put things neatly in their places, the response to a messy classroom.
explain.zh: Tidy up 表示整理；教室凌乱时应把物品放整齐。

prompt.en: The flood left holes in the road. The villagers worked together to ___ the damaged road before the festival.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The flood left holes in the road. The villagers worked together to ___ the damaged road before the festival.

choices: repair
ignore
complain about
avoid
questions.answer: repair

explain.en: Repair means fix damage. The holes caused by the flood explain why the road needed repair.
explain.zh: Repair 表示修补；洪水造成路上有坑洞，所以道路需要修复。

prompt.en: A classmate says, "Thank you for lending me your pencil." Choose a polite reply.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A classmate says, "Thank you for lending me your pencil." Choose a polite reply.

choices: You are welcome.
Where is the canteen?
I am ten years old.
It is Monday.
questions.answer: You are welcome.

explain.en: You are welcome politely responds to thanks. The other answers change the subject.
explain.zh: You are welcome 是回应感谢的礼貌用语；其余答案与感谢无关。

prompt.en: You want to borrow a ruler from your friend. Which sentence makes a polite request?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。You want to borrow a ruler from your friend. Which sentence makes a polite request?

choices: May I borrow your ruler, please?
That ruler is mine now.
Give me the ruler immediately!
You have no ruler.
questions.answer: May I borrow your ruler, please?

explain.en: May I ... please? asks permission politely rather than demanding something.
explain.zh: May I ... please? 是礼貌地请求允许借用，不是命令别人。

prompt.en: The teacher asks, "Where did you put the scissors?" Which reply answers the question?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The teacher asks, "Where did you put the scissors?" Which reply answers the question?

choices: In the drawer beside the door.
Yesterday afternoon.
Because the paper is thick.
There are two pairs.
questions.answer: In the drawer beside the door.

explain.en: Where asks for a place; the drawer beside the door is a place.
explain.zh: Where 询问地点；门旁的抽屉是地点，其他选项回答时间、原因或数量。

prompt.en: A friend invites you to play, but you must finish your homework. Choose a polite refusal.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A friend invites you to play, but you must finish your homework. Choose a polite refusal.

choices: Thank you, but I need to finish my homework first.
You must do all my homework.
I never want to speak to you.
The field has green grass.
questions.answer: Thank you, but I need to finish my homework first.

explain.en: The reply thanks the friend and gives a clear reason for declining.
explain.zh: 这个回答先表示感谢，再说明无法参加的原因，语气礼貌。

prompt.en: Combine without changing the meaning: "The bag is old. It is still useful."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Combine without changing the meaning: "The bag is old. It is still useful."

choices: The bag is old, but it is still useful.
The bag is old because it is still useful.
The bag is old, so it is no longer useful.
The bag is useful only when it is new.
questions.answer: The bag is old, but it is still useful.

explain.en: But links the contrast while keeping both original facts: old and still useful.
explain.zh: But 连接转折，同时保留“旧”和“仍然有用”两个原意。

prompt.en: Combine the ideas to show the reason: "The match stopped. It started to rain heavily."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Combine the ideas to show the reason: "The match stopped. It started to rain heavily."

choices: The match stopped because it started to rain heavily.
It rained because the match stopped.
The match stopped before the rain was expected next week.
The match stopped, but it did not rain.
questions.answer: The match stopped because it started to rain heavily.

explain.en: Because makes heavy rain the reason the match stopped, not a result of stopping it.
explain.zh: Because 说明大雨是比赛停止的原因，不能把因果关系倒转。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence that keeps this meaning: "Please return the book before Friday."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence that keeps this meaning: "Please return the book before Friday."

choices: Bring the book back earlier than Friday.
Bring the book back only after Friday.
Keep the book forever.
Buy a new book on Friday.
questions.answer: Bring the book back earlier than Friday.

explain.en: Return means bring back. Before Friday means earlier than Friday, not after it.
explain.zh: Return 表示归还；before Friday 表示星期五之前，不是星期五之后。

prompt.en: Ravi asks, "Could you tell me how to get to the library?" Which reply gives directions?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Ravi asks, "Could you tell me how to get to the library?" Which reply gives directions?

choices: Go straight and turn left after the hall.
The library has many books.
I read two books yesterday.
My favourite book is about birds.
questions.answer: Go straight and turn left after the hall.

explain.en: Go straight and turn left explain the route. The other replies give book information.
explain.zh: Go straight 和 turn left 说明路线；其余答案没有指路。

prompt.en: A classmate drops her books. Choose the most helpful offer.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A classmate drops her books. Choose the most helpful offer.

choices: Shall I help you pick them up?
Why do books have covers?
Those books are not new.
I do not like that colour.
questions.answer: Shall I help you pick them up?

explain.en: Shall I help ...? offers practical help with the dropped books.
explain.zh: Shall I help ...? 主动提出帮忙捡书，回应了同学的需要。

prompt.en: A notice says, "Please switch off the fan before leaving." Which reminder has the same meaning?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A notice says, "Please switch off the fan before leaving." Which reminder has the same meaning?

choices: Remember to turn the fan off when you leave.
Leave the fan on all night.
Switch on the fan after everyone leaves.
Take the fan home with you.
questions.answer: Remember to turn the fan off when you leave.

explain.en: Switch off and turn off have the same meaning. Both reminders require the fan to stop running.
explain.zh: Switch off 和 turn off 意思相同，都是把风扇关掉。

prompt.en: Choose the best closing sentence for this note: "Dear Mei, Please come to my birthday picnic on Sunday at 4 p.m. at the park. ..."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the best closing sentence for this note: "Dear Mei, Please come to my birthday picnic on Sunday at 4 p.m. at the park. ..."

choices: I hope you can join us!
I have never invited anyone.
Please mark my homework.
The picnic happened last year.
questions.answer: I hope you can join us!

explain.en: The closing expresses a wish for Mei to attend and fits the invitation.
explain.zh: 这个结尾希望 Mei 来参加，符合生日野餐邀请的目的。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence that corrects the error in "She do not like noisy places."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence that corrects the error in "She do not like noisy places."

choices: She does not like noisy places.
She does not likes noisy places.
She do not likes noisy places.
She doing not like noisy places.
questions.answer: She does not like noisy places.

explain.en: She takes does not, followed by the base verb like.
explain.zh: She 后用 does not；后面的 like 保留原形，不能再加 -s。

prompt.en: Choose the correct question to ask about yesterday: "___" "Yes, I visited the museum."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the correct question to ask about yesterday: "___" "Yes, I visited the museum."

choices: Did you visit the museum?
Do you visited the museum?
Were you visit the museum?
Did you visited the museum?
questions.answer: Did you visit the museum?

explain.en: A past yes/no question uses Did + you + visit. Did already marks the past.
explain.zh: 过去式的是非问句用 Did you visit；Did 已表示过去，visit 用原形。

prompt.en: A pupil writes, "We went to melaka in june." Which correction is needed?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A pupil writes, "We went to melaka in june." Which correction is needed?

choices: Write Melaka and June with capital letters.
Write every word in capital letters.
Write went as wents.
Remove both place and month names.
questions.answer: Write Melaka and June with capital letters.

explain.en: Melaka is a place name and June is a month name, so both start with capitals.
explain.zh: Melaka 是地名，June 是月份名称，两者首字母都要大写。

prompt.en: Which sentence correctly shows that one girl owns the bicycle?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Which sentence correctly shows that one girl owns the bicycle?

choices: The girl's bicycle is red.
The girls bicycle is red.
The girls' bicycle is red.
The girl bicycle's is red.
questions.answer: The girl's bicycle is red.

explain.en: One girl takes apostrophe + s: girl's. Girls' would show ownership by more than one girl.
explain.zh: 一个女孩拥有的自行车用 girl's；girls' 表示多个女孩的所属关系。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence that reports these facts accurately: "Mira arrived at 8 a.m. Ravi arrived at 8.15 a.m."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence that reports these facts accurately: "Mira arrived at 8 a.m. Ravi arrived at 8.15 a.m."

choices: Mira arrived before Ravi.
Mira arrived after Ravi.
They arrived at the same time.
Ravi arrived an hour earlier.
questions.answer: Mira arrived before Ravi.

explain.en: 8 a.m. is fifteen minutes before 8.15 a.m., so Mira arrived first.
explain.zh: 上午八点比八点十五分早十五分钟，因此 Mira 先到。

prompt.en: Choose the most suitable sentence for a poster asking pupils to save water.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the most suitable sentence for a poster asking pupils to save water.

choices: Turn off the tap after washing your hands.
Leave the tap running all day.
Use a fresh notebook each week.
Bring a football to class.
questions.answer: Turn off the tap after washing your hands.

explain.en: Turning off a tap directly supports the purpose of saving water.
explain.zh: 洗手后关水龙头，直接符合节约用水的海报目的。

prompt.en: Put the events in order: 1. We ate the sandwiches. 2. We spread butter on the bread. 3. We put the slices together.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Put the events in order: 1. We ate the sandwiches. 2. We spread butter on the bread. 3. We put the slices together.

explain.en: First spread butter, then assemble the sandwiches, and finally eat them.
explain.zh: 先涂牛油，再把面包片合起来，最后才吃，所以是 2、3、1。

prompt.en: Choose the best next sentence: "The sky grew dark. Strong winds shook the trees. ..."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the best next sentence: "The sky grew dark. Strong winds shook the trees. ..."

choices: We went indoors before the storm arrived.
We put away our books because the test ended.
The room smelled of freshly baked bread.
The bus fare was three ringgit.
questions.answer: We went indoors before the storm arrived.

explain.en: Dark skies and strong winds suggest a coming storm; going indoors continues the same event.
explain.zh: 天色转暗和强风预示暴风雨，把“到室内避雨”接在后面最连贯。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence that does NOT fit a paragraph about caring for a school garden.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence that does NOT fit a paragraph about caring for a school garden.

choices: The bus to Ipoh leaves at noon.
We water the plants in the morning.
We remove weeds from the flower beds.
We put dry leaves in the compost bin.
questions.answer: The bus to Ipoh leaves at noon.

explain.en: The bus departure is about travel. The other sentences describe garden care.
explain.zh: 巴士出发时间属于交通信息；另外三句都与照顾花园有关。

prompt.en: "Aina gave her sister a card. She smiled when she received it." Who does She refer to in the second sentence?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。"Aina gave her sister a card. She smiled when she received it." Who does She refer to in the second sentence?

choices: Aina's sister.
The card.
Aina's teacher.
The postman.
questions.answer: Aina's sister.

explain.en: The sister receives the card, so the person who smiles on receiving it is the sister.
explain.zh: 收到卡片的人是 Aina 的姐妹，因此收到后微笑的 She 指姐妹。

prompt.en: Choose the clearest sentence to give these details: "club meeting / Friday / 2 p.m. / Room 4"
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the clearest sentence to give these details: "club meeting / Friday / 2 p.m. / Room 4"

choices: The club meeting is in Room 4 at 2 p.m. on Friday.
Room 4 meets the club in Friday on 2 p.m.
The Friday is at club and Room 4 meets.
The meeting is at Friday in 2 p.m. on Room 4.
questions.answer: The club meeting is in Room 4 at 2 p.m. on Friday.

explain.en: Use in for the room, at for a clock time and on for the day.
explain.zh: 房间前用 in，钟点前用 at，星期几前用 on，句子便能清楚表达所有资料。

prompt.en: A friend says, "I cannot understand this instruction." Choose a useful response.
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。A friend says, "I cannot understand this instruction." Choose a useful response.

choices: Let us read it together and look at the example.
Then you must already know the answer.
The instruction has disappeared forever.
That means the book is too heavy.
questions.answer: Let us read it together and look at the example.

explain.en: Reading together and checking an example directly helps the friend understand.
explain.zh: 一起重读并查看例子，直接帮助朋友理解指示。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence with the same meaning: "Both Siva and Lina brought their lunch."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence with the same meaning: "Both Siva and Lina brought their lunch."

choices: Siva brought lunch, and Lina did too.
Only Siva brought lunch.
Neither pupil brought lunch.
Lina brought lunch instead of Siva.
questions.answer: Siva brought lunch, and Lina did too.

explain.en: Both includes the two people, so each of them brought lunch.
explain.zh: Both 包括两个人，表示 Siva 和 Lina 都带了午餐。

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence using these facts: "The red ribbon is 20 cm. The blue ribbon is 30 cm."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the correct sentence using these facts: "The red ribbon is 20 cm. The blue ribbon is 30 cm."

choices: The blue ribbon is longer than the red ribbon.
The red ribbon is longer than the blue ribbon.
The ribbons are the same length.
The red ribbon is the longest of the two.
questions.answer: The blue ribbon is longer than the red ribbon.

explain.en: 30 cm is longer than 20 cm. Use the comparative longer than for two ribbons.
explain.zh: 30 cm 比 20 cm 长；比较两条缎带用 longer than。

prompt.en: An invitation gives a date and time but no place. Which question asks for the missing information?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。An invitation gives a date and time but no place. Which question asks for the missing information?

choices: Where will the event take place?
When will the event begin?
What is the date?
How old are you?
questions.answer: Where will the event take place?

explain.en: Where asks for the missing place; the date and time have already been given.
explain.zh: Where 询问缺少的地点资料；日期和时间已经提供。

prompt.en: You accidentally step on a friend's foot. Which reply is the most suitable?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。You accidentally step on a friend's foot. Which reply is the most suitable?

choices: I am sorry. Are you all right?
You are welcome. See you tomorrow.
Congratulations on winning!
Please order two bowls of soup.
questions.answer: I am sorry. Are you all right?

explain.en: Apologising and checking that the friend is all right respond to the accident.
explain.zh: 道歉并关心朋友是否受伤，才符合不小心踩到脚的情境。

prompt.en: Choose the correct sentence that uses all these ideas: "Ravi / enjoy / reading / because / learn new things"
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the correct sentence that uses all these ideas: "Ravi / enjoy / reading / because / learn new things"

choices: Ravi enjoys reading because he learns new things.
Ravi enjoy reading because learns he new things.
Ravi enjoys read because he learning new things.
Because Ravi new things he enjoys learns reading.
questions.answer: Ravi enjoys reading because he learns new things.

explain.en: Singular Ravi takes enjoys. Enjoy is followed by reading, and because introduces the reason.
explain.zh: Ravi 是单数，用 enjoys；enjoy 后接 reading，because 引出原因。

prompt.en: The teacher says, "Please speak more slowly so everyone can follow your story." What should the pupil do?
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。The teacher says, "Please speak more slowly so everyone can follow your story." What should the pupil do?

choices: Tell the story at a slower speed.
Speak as fast as possible.
Stop telling stories forever.
Make every sentence much louder.
questions.answer: Tell the story at a slower speed.

explain.en: More slowly concerns speed, not loudness. It helps listeners understand the story.
explain.zh: More slowly 是放慢速度，不是提高音量，这能让听众听明白故事。

prompt.en: Choose the sentence that best joins these ideas in time order: "We washed the vegetables. Then we cooked them."
prompt.zh: 选出最合适的答案。Choose the sentence that best joins these ideas in time order: "We washed the vegetables. Then we cooked them."

choices: We washed the vegetables before cooking them.
We washed the vegetables after eating them.
We cooked the vegetables before washing them.
We never washed or cooked the vegetables.
questions.answer: We washed the vegetables before cooking them.

explain.en: Before cooking them keeps the order: wash first, cook second.
explain.zh: Before cooking them 保留原先的顺序：先洗菜，再煮菜。
